mhspcarpi predicts the 4-year risk of all-cause death with placebo plus androgen deprivation therapy (ADT), called baseline risk, in metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer (mHSPC), and returns the pooled treatment effects of an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) plus ADT at that baseline risk.

```{r}
library(mhspcarpi)
```

## Inputs

`model_inputs()` lists the 9 predictors with their column names, units, accepted values, and scoring. `example_patients` contains 6 synthetic patients spanning the range of baseline risk.

```{r}
model_inputs()[c("name", "unit", "accepted", "scoring")]
example_patients
```

## Baseline risk

`predict_baseline_risk()` returns the shrunken, centered linear predictor and the 4-year risk. The `notes` column flags values outside the development data and baseline risks outside the range in which treatment effects were estimated.

```{r}
predict_baseline_risk(example_patients)
```

## Treatment effects

`estimate_treatment_effect()` returns, in long format, the absolute risk difference at 4 years (`ard`), the restricted mean survival time difference through 4 years in months (`rmst`), and the hazard ratio (`hr`), each with a 95% confidence interval (`conf_low`, `conf_high`) and a 95% prediction interval for a new trial population (`pred_low`, `pred_high`).

```{r}
effects <- estimate_treatment_effect(example_patients)
effects[effects$row == 3, c("scale", "estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high", "pred_low", "pred_high")]
```

Baseline risks outside the 1st to 99th percentiles of the trials receive the effect at the nearest edge of that range, with `in_effect_range = FALSE`.

`treatment_effect_curve()` returns the pooled curves across baseline risk, for figures or tables.

```{r}
head(treatment_effect_curve("rmst"))
```

## Checking inputs

`check_inputs()` stops with an informative error for missing or impossible values and returns warnings and notes for values outside the development data.

```{r}
#| error: true
patient <- example_patients[1, ]
patient$hemoglobin <- -1
check_inputs(patient)
```

```{r}
patient$hemoglobin <- 150
patient$psa <- 20000
check_inputs(patient)
```

## Model specification

```{r}
mhspc_model()
```

The specification is at `system.file("extdata", "model_spec.json", package = "mhspcarpi")`.
